pearl.command:
#!/bin/bash

exec > >(tee -a /root/autorent.log)
exec 2>&1

set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "===== START $(date) ====="

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y wget tar screen ca-certificates

cd /root

wget -O wildrig.tar.gz https://github.com/andru-kun/wildrig-multi/releases/download/0.51.5/wildrig-multi-linux-0.51.5.tar.gz

mkdir -p wildrig
tar -xzf wildrig.tar.gz -C wildrig
chmod +x /root/wildrig/wildrig-multi

cat >/root/wildrig/run.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

cd /root/wildrig

./wildrig-multi \
  --algo pearlhash \
  --url stratum+tcp://pool.pearlhash.xyz:9000 \
  --user prl1px59q5kxksa2vtnq56xfgyhr6c7ke3n2q52dg9xzfd7pjcf2mwayqyzluh4.SERVER_ID \
  --pass x
EOF

chmod +x /root/wildrig/run.sh

screen -S pearl -X quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
screen -dmS pearl bash -c "/root/wildrig/run.sh; echo EXIT_CODE=\$?; sleep 600"

echo "===== FINISHED ====="

quan.command:
#!/bin/bash

exec > >(tee -a /root/autorent.log)
exec 2>&1

set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo '===== START '$(date)' ====='

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y wget screen ca-certificates

mkdir -p ~/quantus && cd ~/quantus
wget -O quanpool-miner-6.4.0 https://download.quanpool.com/quanpool-miner-6.4.0-linux-x86_64
echo 'b3663cc6e7acc0a006e5d3d8c03dbce85e7c6a67cb922412a32703c18a5c4c20  quanpool-miner-6.4.0' | sha256sum -c
chmod u+x quanpool-miner-6.4.0

./quanpool-miner-6.4.0 serve --node-addr stratum+ssl://global.quanpool.com:9855 --auth-token qzmq1DSuKJdzodCs6LboBDx966iDuPkYoYo5CLt5ctmRoj9c7.SERVER_ID

echo '===== FINISHED ====='
